definition: The Fireworks Algorithm (FWA) is a swarm intelligence algorithm that explores a very large solution space by choosing a set of random points confined by some distance metric in the hopes that one or more of them will yield promising results, allowing for a more concentrated search nearby..

story: Imagine a driving test that every new model has to pass before it is allowed on the road. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. It is the exam that keeps everyone honest. And that, done honestly, is Fireworks algorithm.
